column1: # transcript.tsv: scripted Keccak256Transcript<E> (nova-snark 0.76.0 provider/keccak.rs) sessions, engine = pallas | vesta.
# Challenges are E::Scalar: pallas engine -> fq, vesta engine -> fp. Field elements 64 hex (32 B LE).
# Algorithm (also re-implemented independently in this generator and asserted equal):
# new(label):    state = lohi("", "NoTR" || label), round = 0, buf = ""
# squeeze(label): input = "NoDS" || round.to_le_bytes() (u64) || state (64 B) || label; state' = lohi(buf, input); round += 1; buf = ""; challenge = Scalar::from_uniform_bytes(state')
# lohi(prefix, input): h = Keccak256(prefix || input); lo = Keccak256(prefix || input || 0x00), hi = Keccak256(prefix || input || 0x01); output = lo || hi (64 B). (Keccak256 original padding.)

# squeeze_bits(label, nb, one): same state update; value = little-endian integer from the first nb bits of state' (byte i = state'[i], the partial byte masked), then if one the bit nb-1 is forced to 1

# to_transcript_bytes: scalar = 32 B LE repr; &[scalar] = concatenation; Commitment = x(32 LE) || y(32 LE) || infinity byte (1 = identity, then x=y=0); UniPoly = coefficients except the linear term (coeffs[0], coeffs[2], coeffs[3] for a cubic), 32 B LE each.
# absorb <label> <kind> <bytes hex>      (kind: scalar|scalars|commitment|unipoly, informational; the hex is exactly what is appended after the label)
# squeeze <label> <challenge hex> <state' 64 B hex> <round index used>
